conditionalOverlap.scope: Conditional intersection bounds per origin: lower=max(0,sum(served)-(K-1)*population), upper=min(served). These are not observed patient identities.

generation.method: Bounded common-resource location/template/physician cost MIP plus optional fixed-resource travel assignment

scope: Feasible common resources for 44 sampled minute starts only. No guarantee between sampled seconds, throughout the day, for real EGO service, clinical staffing, public budgets, minimum hospital count, or a 91-hospital conclusion. Annual demand and cost are counted once.
generationReferenceScope: Run and vector hashes identify generation artifacts; this validator does not replay optimization or certify a solver bound.

runArtifactAudit.scope: Final JSON and raw vector agree exactly. Source seed is validated for its original four profiles only; its older flows are not a window fallback. Native cost bounds remain limited to the reported candidate pool and named model profiles.
